name: tencent/hy4-flash
description: Hy4 flash is the cost-efficient tier of Tencent Hunyuan's Hy4 family, with roughly a quarter of the flagship's parameters for lower latency and cost. It accepts text and image input, has a context window of about 1M tokens, and supports reasoning, tool calling and structured output. It targets code assistance, agent workflows and high-volume tasks where Hy4's full depth is not needed.
